newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian goods/services in surplus in April.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian goods/services in surplus in April.

text.p: Australia's seasonally adjusted balance on goods and services showed a surplus of A$302 million in April compared to March's deficit of A$103 million, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with a seasonally adjusted surplus of A$29 million in April 1996.
Economists' median forecast had been for a surplus of around A$100 million for the balance of goods and services.
EXPORTS: Rural goods 2.004 bln 1.858 bln 1.872 bln
IMPORTS: Consumption goods 1.788 bln 1.738 bln 1.665 bln
Balance of goods/svcs +302 million -103 million +29 million
The Bureau said total exports of goods and services rose six percent, seasonally adjusted, while imports rose one percent.
Exports of goods alone rose eight percent, while imports rose $28 million to A$6.777 billion.
The trend estimate on the balance of goods and services recorded a surplus of A$166 million in April, the 14th consecutive surplus in this balance.
